desc: The choice for competition shooters, Selection Precision rimfire loads were developed with reliability and accuracy, both key elements in competitive shooting. CCI designed this 22 Long Rifle ammo to keep actions cleaner with clean-burning propellants, and to feature trusted CCI sure-fire priming technology. CCI is known in the shooting sports industry for having reliable ammunition that delivers exceptional performance time and time again. This ammunition is new production and non-corrosive.
